title: Welcome to your new Blog!
content:
Hello World!

This is your first post. You can edit or delete it from the admin panel.

This CMS is designed to be lightweight, fast, and easy to use. It uses flat files (JSON) for storage, meaning no database setup is required!

Features:

  • Markdown & HTML support
  • Responsive Default Theme
  • Light/Dark mode
  • Customizable Sidebar & Widgets
  • Simple Media Manager
excerpt: Welcome to your new lightweight blogging CMS! This is a demo post to show you how things look.
